title: "calculating pagel's lambda"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(usethis)
library(devtools)
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(phytools)
```

```{r}
#install the package for making the phylogenetic tree
install_github("jinyizju/V.PhyloMaker")

library(V.PhyloMaker)
```

```{r}
#now I need to get my cleaned list of species, with a species, genus and family column

#make a vector of species
species_list <- read.csv(here("species list data", "final corrected species list.csv"))
```

```{r}
list_sp_cleaned <- species_list %>%
  select(binomial_name, genus, family) %>%
  # Ensure characters are valid UTF-8, replace non-breaking spaces
  mutate(
    binomial_name = iconv(binomial_name, from = "", to = "UTF-8"),       # fix encoding
    binomial_name = gsub("\u00A0", " ", binomial_name, useBytes = TRUE)  # replace NBSP
  ) %>%
  # Remove unwanted placeholders
  filter(!grepl(
    "(?i)\\bunknown\\b|\\bmixed\\b|\\b(species|sp)\\.?\\s*\\d*$",
    binomial_name
  )) %>%
  # Drop rows with NA binomial_name
  filter(!is.na(binomial_name)) %>%
  rename(species = "binomial_name")
```

```{r}
result <- phylo.maker(list_sp_cleaned, scenarios=c("S1","S2","S3"))


# Extract each scenario as a separate phylo object
Scenario1_tree <- result$scenario.1
Scenario2_tree <- result$scenario.2$tree
Scenario3_tree <- result$scenario.3$tree

# Check classes
class(Scenario1_tree)  # should be "phylo"
class(Scenario2_tree)
class(Scenario3_tree)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot.phylo(result$scenario.1, cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.1", show.tip.label= FALSE)
#nodelabels(round(branching.times(result$scenario.1), 1), cex = 1)
#
# plot a circular tree
plot.phylo(result$scenario.1, type = "fan", cex = 0.5, show.tip.label = FALSE)
```


```{r}
plot.phylo(result$scenario.2[[1]], cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.2", show.tip.label= FALSE)
#nodelabels(round(branching.times(result$scenario.2[[1]]), 1), cex = 1)
```


```{r}
plot.phylo(result$scenario.3, cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.3", show.tip.label= FALSE)
#nodelabels(round(branching.times(result$scenario.3), 1), cex = 1)
```


```{r}
#now actually calculate pagel's lambda
#
all_traits_dataset <- read.csv(here("processed trait data", "all traits database.csv"))

log_seed_mass <- log(setNames(all_traits_dataset$mean_dry_seed_mass_mg, rownames(all_traits_dataset)))


K.seed_mass<-phylosig(Scenario1_tree, log_seed_mass,
    test=TRUE)
print(K.seed_mass)
```
